title: Milken's Freylekh
program_note:
Milken’s Freylekh was written for the launch of the Lowell Milken Center for Music of American Jewish Experience at UCLA.  It is meant to be a joyous celebration (“frolic!”) of a few different types of music (including an arithmetic scale I enjoy using, plus there is a hidden quote thrown in), all rolled up into a short klezmer whole.
The music is about one and a half minutes in duration.

David S. Lefkowitz
Los Angeles, CA
17 August, 2020
